verses.english: Woe to the defrauders, who use short measures,

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
verses.english: who, when they measure [a commodity bought] from the people, take the full measure,
verses.transliteration_html: Allatheena itha iktaloo AAala alnnasi yastawfoona
verses.transliteration_text: Allatheena itha iktaloo AAala alnnasi yastawfoona

verses.english: but diminish when they measure or weigh for them.
Do they not know that they will be resurrected
on a tremendous day,
a day when mankind will stand before the Lord of all the worlds?

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ
verses.english: Indeed, the record of the vicious is in Sijjeen.
verses.transliteration_html: Kalla inna kitaba alfujjari lafee sijjeenin
verses.transliteration_text: Kalla inna kitaba alfujjari lafee sijjeenin

verses.english: And what will show you what is Sijjeen?
It is a written record.
Woe to the deniers on that day,
who deny the Day of Retribution;

verses.arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.english: and none denies it except every sinful transgressor.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama yukaththibu bihi illa kullu muAAtadin atheemin
verses.transliteration_text: Wama yukaththibu bihi illa kullu muAAtadin atheemin

verses.arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.english: When Our signs are recited to him, he says, ‘Myths of the ancients!’
verses.transliteration_html: Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatuna qala asateeru alawwaleena
verses.transliteration_text: Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatuna qala asateeru alawwaleena

verses.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.english: No, that is not the case! Rather, their hearts have been sullied by what they have been earning.
verses.transliteration_html: Kalla bal rana AAala quloobihim ma kanoo yaksiboona
verses.transliteration_text: Kalla bal rana AAala quloobihim ma kanoo yaksiboona

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
verses.english: Indeed, they will be alienated from their Lord on that day.
verses.transliteration_html: Kalla innahum AAan rabbihim yawmaithin lamahjooboona
verses.transliteration_text: Kalla innahum AAan rabbihim yawmaithin lamahjooboona

verses.english: Afterward they will enter hell,

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.english: then told, ‘This is what you used to deny!’
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma yuqalu hatha allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma yuqalu hatha allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona

verses.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
verses.english: Indeed, the record of the pious is in Illeeyun.
verses.transliteration_html: Kalla inna kitaba alabrari lafee AAilliyyeena
verses.transliteration_text: Kalla inna kitaba alabrari lafee AAilliyyeena

verses.english: And what will show you what is Illeeyun?
It is a written record,
witnessed by those brought near [to Allah].
The pious shall be amid bliss,
observing, [as they recline] on couches.
You will perceive in their faces the freshness of bliss.
They will be served with a sealed pure wine,

verses.arabic: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ
verses.english: whose seal is musk—for such let the viers vie—
verses.transliteration_text: Khitamuhu miskun wafee thalika falyatanafasi almutanafisoona

verses.english: and whose seasoning is from Tasneem,
a spring where those brought near [to Allah] drink.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.english: Indeed the guilty used to laugh at the faithful,
verses.transliteration_html: Inna allatheena ajramoo kanoo mina allatheena amanoo yadhakoona
verses.transliteration_text: Inna allatheena ajramoo kanoo mina allatheena amanoo yadhakoona

verses.english: and when they passed them by they would wink at each other,

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
verses.english: and when they returned to their folks they would return amused,
verses.transliteration_html: Waitha inqalaboo ila ahlihimu inqalaboo fakiheena
verses.transliteration_text: Waitha inqalaboo ila ahlihimu inqalaboo fakiheena

verses.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
verses.english: and when they saw them they would say, ‘Indeed those are the astray!’
verses.transliteration_html: Waitha raawhum qaloo inna haolai ladalloona
verses.transliteration_text: Waitha raawhum qaloo inna haolai ladalloona

verses.english: Though they were not sent to watch over them.

verses.arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.english: So today the faithful will laugh at the faithless,
verses.transliteration_text: Faalyawma allatheena amanoo mina alkuffari yadhakoona

verses.english: observing from their couches:

verses.arabic: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.english: Have the faithless been requited for what they used to do?
verses.transliteration_html: Hal thuwwiba alkuffaru ma kanoo yafAAaloona
verses.transliteration_text: Hal thuwwiba alkuffaru ma kanoo yafAAaloona
